section.heading: Recovery of penalty or compensation
section.html: 64. Recovery of 1 [penalty or compensation].--A 2 [penalty imposed or compensation awarded] under this Act, if it is not paid, shall he recovered as an arrear of land revenue and the licence or the 3 [electronic signature] Certificate, as the case may be, shall be suspended till the penalty is paid.
